title: Plate with a hole (free mesh)
sentence: A plane-stress plate with a circular hole in tension, free-meshed with local refinement around the hole.

expected.reference: ≈ 3σ with σ = 10 kN / (80 × 10 mm) = 12.5 MPa, raised by the finite width

theory: The everyday counterpart of `kirsch-quarter-plate`: the same $K_t \approx 3$ concentration, but on an unstructured triangular mesh over the whole plate rather than a graded quarter model. The finite width raises $K_t$ above the infinite-plate value, and the ligament between hole and edge carries more than the nominal stress.
